iWant: to name my Squire and give it a personality in a guided first conversation, and have it keep them
soThat: my Squire feels like mine and stays that way after fresh starts and updates
description: The guided first conversation covers what Squire can do, how approval works, the Squire owner's privacy words, house style, fresh starts and where pages appear; it can pause and resume. Plain words, short answers and a teach-me mode are reviewed behaviour (a person reads the help text and a sample of answers against the house style), not a criterion.
title: The first conversation: a Squire with the name and personality its owner gives it

acceptanceCriteria.description: Squire keeps the name and personality the Squire owner gives it, and uses them in its replies.
acceptanceCriteria.given: A Squire owner who has named their Squire and given it a personality
acceptanceCriteria.when: Squire starts afresh, and after Squire is updated
acceptanceCriteria.then: The name and personality are unchanged, and Squire's replies use them.
